author: ETA PRIME
description:
Today, we are putting the ultra-portable 45W OneXPlayer 3 head-to-head against the 140W Valve Steam Machine to see if a handheld can actually dethrone a dedicated living room console in raw frame rates! The OneXPlayer 3 is a versatile 3-in-1 Windows 11 device. It is powered by the new Intel Arc G3 Extreme processor and B390 integrated graphics based on the Xe3 architecture. On the other side of the desk, Valve's compact 6-inch Steam Machine packs a semi-custom AMD Zen 4 CPU and an RDNA3 GPU featuring 28 compute units.
